conservation.condition_narrative: The artwork is in very good condition. The canvas is in plane and the paint is well adhered to the support. A vertical crack is present on the lower PL edge, which appears to correspond to a stretcher bar location. A raised area is present on the middle-upper PR edge, which also appears to correspond to a stretcher bar location. A small scuff is present at the lower center of the composition, where the boom and mast meet.
conservation.report_notes: Information provided for *Access O'Keeffe* by Toledo Museum of Art  in 2025.
conservation.technical_description: The artwork is an oil on canvas painting. The canvas is a plain weave of unknown fiber composition. The paint application varies in thickness and apparent application method, which appears to include brush and palette knife.

description: The brown sails of a boat, seen as if the viewer is standing on the ship itself, form a triangle at the center of the composition. The pink bow of the ship juts into the canvas from the bottom edge. A thin strip of water and a shore are visible in the distance. A lighthouse stands on the beach. A blue sky filled with fluffy white clouds fills the rest of the image.
